description: NaLaScSbO₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.66 Å. La is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.53 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-30°. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.15 Å. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-30°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.02 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one La, one Sc, and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Sb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, one Sc, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, one Sc, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, one Sc, and one Sb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, one Sc, and one Sb atom.
